I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47. In the same reply I explained that Pree posted Dock 23 there on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 that morning. I took the answer only from #central-team, which Hollis is a member of.

The brain (gbrain) refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so I didn't get anything from it. Fixing that means rebinding the token on the brain host, and I haven't made that change.
